mapper.select: SELECT CONCAT('sys_', sn.id) AS id, sn.type AS type, sn.actor_user_id AS actor_user_id, u.username AS actor_user_name, u.avatar_url AS actor_user_avatar, sn.message AS message, sn.create_time AS create_time, sn.post_id AS post_id, sn.unread AS unread FROM system_notification sn INNER JOIN `user` u ON u.id = sn.actor_user_id WHERE sn.target_user_id = #{userId} AND sn.type IN ('LIKE', 'FAVORITE', 'LIKE_COMMENT') ORDER BY sn.create_time DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT CONCAT('sys_', sn.id) AS id, sn.type AS type, sn.actor_user_id AS actor_user_id, u.username AS actor_user_name, u.avatar_url AS actor_user_avatar, sn.message AS message, sn.create_time AS create_time, sn.post_id AS post_id, sn.unread AS unread FROM system_notification sn INNER JOIN `user` u ON u.id = sn.actor_user_id WHERE sn.target_user_id = #{userId} AND sn.type IN ('COMMENT', 'MENTION') ORDER BY sn.create_time DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT CONCAT('sys_', sn.id) AS id, sn.type AS type, sn.actor_user_id AS actor_user_id, u.username AS actor_user_name, u.avatar_url AS actor_user_avatar, sn.message AS message, sn.create_time AS create_time, sn.post_id AS post_id, sn.unread AS unread FROM system_notification sn INNER JOIN `user` u ON u.id = sn.actor_user_id WHERE sn.target_user_id = #{userId} AND sn.type = 'FOLLOW' ORDER BY sn.create_time DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT CONCAT('sys_', sn.id) AS id, sn.type AS type, sn.actor_user_id AS actor_user_id, COALESCE(u.username, '系统') AS actor_user_name, u.avatar_url AS actor_user_avatar, sn.message AS message, sn.create_time AS create_time, sn.post_id AS post_id, sn.unread AS unread FROM system_notification sn LEFT JOIN `user` u ON u.id = sn.actor_user_id WHERE sn.target_user_id = #{userId} AND sn.type NOT IN ('LIKE', 'FAVORITE', 'LIKE_COMMENT', 'COMMENT', 'MENTION', 'FOLLOW') ORDER BY sn.create_time DESC LIMIT 100
